video_title: They Totaled this 718 GT4, so I'm Building the GT4RS that Porsche Won't (6-Speed Manual)
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies WOLFBOX as the sponsor of Matt Ross's July 4, 2026 English-language YouTube video and shows WOLFBOX as a repeat sponsor on the channel. WOLFBOX sells physical dash cams, rear-view mirror cameras, and vehicle hardware. WOLFBOX's official Content Creator Program actively recruits YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Amazon creators, and its official contact page publishes branding@wolfbox.com specifically for Influencers and partner@wolfbox.com for Branding and Social Media. GitHub brand search was rechecked immediately before staging and surfaced no WOLFBOX/wolfbox.com match.
